title: The Day of the Leftover Confetti
skyStory: A crescent moon slinks through Scorpio like a cat that knocked something off the counter and refuses to discuss it. The big night is over. The confetti remains. Scorpio wants you to find one piece of it in an impossible place and keep it as evidence that the year really started. Saturn nods slowly over a mug.

reading: The cabin is quiet this morning, chimney smoking lazily, and you will try to start a project anyway. Mars approves. The moon does not. The moon would like you to sit in a chair facing a window for twelve full minutes and do nothing except watch snow behaving.

You will find a piece of confetti somewhere it has no business being: a sock, a book, the inside of a mitten. That is your receipt from the universe for the year's first delivery of joy. The [[Six of Pentacles]] says you do not need to earn it back. Just say thanks, out loud, to the confetti. Yes, really.
joel.mission: Spend twelve minutes by a window doing nothing. Set a timer. If you reach for your phone, the snow wins a point.
joel.omen: A chickadee landing on something metal at 2:15 pm. It means a plan you shelved last year wants back on the table, gently.
joel.elementWhy: a slow day in heavy boots

reading: Wood Rat, your radar is extra sharp today, and it will pick up something everyone else misses: a small kindness across a room, a clerk humming the very tune you were thinking. Write it down. It is the first entry in a collection you did not know you were starting.

The [[Nine of Cups]] tries to whisper that you should want something shinier this year. Ignore it politely. The wish you already have, the one about helping people level up, is the real one. By evening somebody will message to say a thing you taught them actually worked. Screenshot it. Save it in a folder called Proof.
nancy.mission: Start a list titled Things Nobody Else Noticed and add three entries before bed.
nancy.omen: Someone whistling off key in a hallway. It means a door you knocked on in December is about to open.
nancy.stoneWhy: soft light for a soft day

together.text: Declare January second an official Do Nothing Summit. Each of you reports one thing you did not do today and how proud you are of not doing it. Saturn will chair the meeting. Mars will be asked to leave twice.
